why: Egypt's delivery market is growing fast. Riders, zones, cash-on-delivery and proof of delivery are the core ops every courier needs.
operator: The courier owner manages a fleet of riders and vehicles. Their day is job assignments, route changes, cash reconciliation and proving each delivery arrived on time.
entities: CourierCompany (id, nameAr, nameEn, branchId, phone, email, taxRegistration)
Rider (id, name, phone, vehicleId, status, commissionRate, earningsPiasters)
Zone (id, nameAr, nameEn, areas, minRadius, maxRadius)
DeliveryOrder (id, companyId, customerPhone, customerName, pickupName, pickupAddr, deliveryAddr, status, zoneId, assignedRider, codAmountPiasters, deliveredAt, proofType, proofRef)
Route (id, companyId, orderIds, waypoints, estimatedDuration, actualDuration)
units: piece, kilogram, litre, box, envelope, parcel
batches: No : delivery orders carry no stock or expiry
expiry: Not applicable. Orders are time-sensitive not product-sensitive
special: The core structures are the delivery order with its status lifecycle, the zone geometry for route planning, the COD reconciliation and the proof-of-delivery (photo or signature) artefact
screens: Dashboard: today's assignments, unassigned orders, rider status and zone heat map
Order intake: create a new delivery order with pickup, delivery address, COD amount and service type
Route map: assigned orders on a map with rider location and ETA
COD reconciliation: counted cash vs expected per shift, variance and audit log
Proof of delivery: photo upload, signature capture, customer confirmation
Rider panel: assigned orders, route, earnings, pause/resume
Customer status: live order tracking with ETA and delivery completed notice
roles: Owner: everything : fleet, pricing, payouts, reports
Manager: riders, zones, order assignments, payout approval
Cashier: COD counting, shift close, variance reporting
Rider: assigned orders only, status updates, pause/resume
reports: Daily dispatch report: orders dispatched, dispatched per zone, on-time rate
COD summary: counted vs expected, variance, trends
Rider performance: completed orders, earnings, on-time rate
Zone analytics: orders per zone, peak times, unassigned rate
Customer repeat rate: opt-in WhatsApp and return orders
integrations: Web GPS tracker for rider location
WhatsApp Business for customer delivery updates
Paymob or Fawry for COD card collection (optional)
onboarding: Company basics: name, branch, address, phone, currency, working hours
Zones: define the geographic zones riders operate in
Riders: add riders with contact and commission terms
Service types: define the delivery categories (same-day, scheduled, COD)
First week plan: assign first rider, first order, first route, first COD close
seed: No sector-specific seed data. The engine provides the order schema and role templates.

tasks.title: Add delivery order creation screen with COD field
tasks.brief: Build the UI for creating a new delivery order: pickup, delivery address, COD amount, service type, zone assignment. Done when the form validates and creates an order doc in Firestore.
tasks.done: When the order creation form works and persists data

tasks.title: Implement rider assignment and zone picker
tasks.brief: Build the rider assignment UI with zone picker. Done when a rider can be assigned to an order and the zone geometry validates.

tasks.title: Add COD shift reconciliation screen
tasks.brief: Build the screen that counts cash collected vs expected per shift with variance and audit log. Done when the numbers reconcile and the log is append-only.
tasks.done: When COD reconciliation works and saves to audit log

tasks.title: Add rider dashboard with order list and status update
tasks.brief: Build the rider-side dashboard showing assigned orders, ETA and status buttons (picked, in-progress, completed, cancelled). Done when the rider can update status and it propagates.
tasks.done: When rider status updates propagate to the dashboard

tasks.title: Add WhatsApp deep link for customer order status
tasks.brief: Build the WhatsApp deep link that sends the customer a status update. Done when the link opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled status message.
tasks.done: When the link opens WhatsApp with the correct chat

tasks.title: Add route map with rider location
tasks.brief: Build the map view showing assigned orders and rider location with ETA. Done when the map loads and rider position updates.
tasks.done: When the route map displays correctly

tasks.title: Add electronic proof of delivery (photo/signature)
tasks.brief: Build the proof capture UI: photo upload or signature input. Done when the proof is saved to the order doc and visible in the dashboard.
tasks.done: When proof of delivery is saved and viewable

tasks.title: Add daily dispatch report
tasks.brief: Build the report screen showing today's dispatched orders, on-time rate per zone, and unassigned count. Done when the report displays real data from Firestore.
tasks.done: When the report pulls live data and displays correctly

tasks.title: Add rider earnings calculator
tasks.brief: Build the earnings calculator that computes rider commission per completed order. Done when the math matches the commission rate and order COD.
tasks.done: When earnings compute correctly per rider

tasks.title: Add rider onboarding flow (first ride)
tasks.brief: Build the onboarding flow for a new rider: company welcome, zone assignment, first order, first payout. Done when the flow completes and the rider appears in the system.
tasks.done: When the onboarding flow works end-to-end

risks: Riders may deliver to wrong address without photo proof
COD variance can grow if counting is inconsistent
GPS tracking accuracy depends on phone and network
WhatsApp template rejection if not approved by Meta
